description: A stereo equaliser with eight fixed bands and a master level

params.text: Sets the level of the whole output, -70dB to +6dB
Cuts or boosts the band at 60Hz, a low shelf, -12dB to +12dB
Cuts or boosts the band at 170Hz, -12dB to +12dB
Cuts or boosts the band at 310Hz, -12dB to +12dB
Cuts or boosts the band at 600Hz, -12dB to +12dB
Cuts or boosts the band at 1kHz, -12dB to +12dB
Cuts or boosts the band at 3kHz, -12dB to +12dB
Cuts or boosts the band at 6kHz, -12dB to +12dB
Cuts or boosts the band at 12kHz, a high shelf, -12dB to +12dB

notes: the module has no CV inputs at all, so everything here is set by hand
the lamp beside a band brightens with the energy the output carries around that band's frequency
menu: EQ8 Options — a heading over the items under it
Reset All Bands — returns all eight band sliders to 0dB
Flat Response — sets all eight bands to 0dB
Smile Curve — lifts the low and high bands and drops the middle ones
Bass Boost — lifts the low bands
Presence Boost — lifts the upper middle bands
Soft Clip Outputs — rounds the peaks of the output in place of letting it clip hard, and comes up off
